friends.title: My leagues
friends.intro: Compete with your friends or your class. Free for everyone.
friends.emptyTitle: You’re not in any friends league yet
friends.emptyBody: Create one and share the link, or join with a code someone gave you.
friends.limits: You can create up to {owned} leagues and be in {joined}. Each league holds up to {members} people.
friends.atOwnLimit: You’ve created {n} leagues, the maximum. Delete one to create another.
friends.atJoinLimit: You’re in {n} leagues, the maximum. Leave one to join another.
friends.noPrizes: No money prizes: you play to learn, and for bragging rights.
friends.codeHint: 8 letters and numbers. No O, I, L, 0 or 1.
friends.guestCreate: To create a league, save your progress with an email and password first.
friends.inviteText: Join my league “{name}” on E-Trading: we learn to invest and compete every week, with no real money. {link}
friends.weekRule: Same points as the general league: this week’s XP + investing (10 points for every 1% your portfolio gains, up to ±100).
friends.monthRule: Your portfolio’s return this month. It counts up to ±10%, and if more than 40% is in a single stock, gains count half. Max’s extra balance and resets are not returns. Not invested: 0%.
friends.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the league? They won’t be able to rejoin with the code.
friends.removeNote: People you remove can’t rejoin this league.
friends.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? It disappears for everyone and can’t be undone.
friends.leaveConfirm: Leave “{name}”? You can rejoin with the code.
friends.leaveConfirmOwner: Leave “{name}”? The league will pass to whoever has been in it longest. If nobody is left, it will be deleted.
friends.joinPageBody: Learn to invest and compete every week with lessons and a virtual portfolio. Free, with no real money.
friends.invited: You’ve been invited to a league
friends.maxNote: Create your account with this link and get 7 days of Max for free.
friends.afterAuth: Once your account is ready, you’ll join the league.
friends.finishOnboarding: Finish the welcome steps and you’ll join the league.
friends.badLinkBody: The league no longer exists or the code was copied wrong. Ask whoever sent it to send it again.

errors.INVALID_NAME: The name must be between 3 and 30 characters.
errors.INVALID_CODE: The code has 8 letters and numbers (no O, I, L, 0 or 1). Check it.
errors.LEAGUE_NOT_FOUND: There’s no league with that code. Check it’s typed correctly.
errors.LEAGUE_NOT_FOUND_VIEW: This league doesn’t exist or you’re no longer in it.
errors.LEAGUE_FULL: This league already has 100 members, the maximum.
errors.JOIN_LIMIT: You’re already in 10 leagues, the maximum. Leave one first.
errors.OWN_LIMIT: You’ve already created 5 leagues, the maximum. Delete one to create another.
errors.REMOVED_FROM_LEAGUE: The league’s creator removed you, so you can’t rejoin.
errors.GUEST_MUST_SAVE: Save your progress with an email and password to create a league.
errors.NOT_OWNER: Only the league’s creator can do this.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: That person is no longer in the league.
errors.CANNOT_REMOVE_OWNER: You can’t remove yourself: delete the league if you want.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
errors.VIEW_ONLY: You’re viewing the app as someone else: read-only.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again.
